title: artemisia ludoviciana var. serrata
intro: Artemisia ludoviciana var. serrata, commonly known as Silver Sage or Western Mugwort, is a perennial herb that belongs to the Asteraceae family. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, menstrual cramps, and respiratory problems. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and antimicrobial properties, which are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents like sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. The bioactive constituents of Silver Sage are responsible for its medicinal properties, making it a valuable herb in traditional medicine.
